name: bespunky-voice
description: Hear Claude's questions and answer by voice, for when you're away from the screen. Questions are asked the way a person asks them (`/voice say`, or automatically with `/voice auto on`); `/voice replay` and `/voice stop` repeat or silence it. The `voice-conversation` skill + `ask_by_voice` MCP tool run a hands-free back-and-forth with a live transcript as you speak. Swappable TTS (espeak-ng / say, upgradable to local Piper), local whisper.cpp STT; audio bridged by the BeSpunky devcontainer.
